'''Oxixo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who served as a [[TIE pilot]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Hasbro" /> In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] attempted to attack and destroy the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Oxixo flew a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] to defend the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] from the Rebel [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="Hasbro" /> The battle ended in an Imperial defeat, along with the destruction of the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> Oxixo had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and light skin. An elite pilot, Oxixo had bravery, skill, and loyalty to the Empire, with a chief goal of victory during the Battle of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. Oxixo was one of several elite pilots who knew they were deciding [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] future during the battle, and the pilots did everything they could to complete their mission. Oxixo wielded an [[SE-14r light repeating blaster/Legends|SE-14r light repeating blaster]].<ref name="Hasbro" />

==Behind the scenes==
Oxixo was first mentioned and given an action figure in the "Battle Over Endor" set of [[2010]]'s ''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Dark Side]]''.<ref name="Hasbro" />
